# `skill/v1` — <name>.md — skill module

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.SkillMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Reusable prompt module. Builtins ship under
`priv/templates/skills/`; user overrides shadow by filename
under `~/.glorbo/skills/`. Referenced from an agent's
`AGENT.md` via `skills: [name]`.

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `name`, `description`

**Optional:** `tags`, `version`

### Patterns

| Key | Regex |
|-----|-------|
| `name` | `\A[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}\z` |


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `name`, `description`, `version`, `tags`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: skill/v1
name: code-review
description: Structured code review covering bugs, security, style.
tags: [engineering, review]
---
# code-review

## Purpose

Review code along four dimensions: correctness, security, style, maintainability.
```
